title: Aliens have visited humanity for a very long time
summary: Dan Sherman tells of Aliens have visited humanity for a very long time, about early 1990s (communication); deep past at Earth, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: several times. Um my impression was that they've been here for a very long time.

plain: A former US Army sergeant named Dan Sherman told podcast host Jesse Michels that in the early 1990s the NSA, the US government's code-breaking and eavesdropping agency, hired him to communicate with aliens. He says he did this several times, and his impression from those contacts was that the beings have been on Earth for a very long time. If true, it would mean humans have had visitors since the deep past.
